content:
《Bad Monkey》is an excellent comedy on Apple TV, created by Bill Lawrence, who previously made Ted Lasso and Shrinking—and the show is about to launch a new season. Here are the details.

《Bad Monkey》Season 2 will premiere on December 2

Bill Lawrence has become one of the most prolific golden-age producers in television comedy in recent years. He is by no means a newcomer to the comedy genre, having already achieved success earlier in his career with shows such as Scrubs and Cougar Town.

But moving into the streaming era, Lawrence's producing credits include Ted Lasso, Shrinking, the HBO series Rooster, and the Vince Vaughn-led comedy Bad Monkey.

Shrinking wrapped earlier this year, Ted Lasso is currently airing, and Apple has just announced that Bad Monkey is set to return for a new season.

《Bad Monkey》Season 2 will premiere on December 2 (Wednesday) with its first two episodes, and will then release one new episode per week until February 3.

Here is the official synopsis:

Vince Vaughn stars in the lead role, with John Malkovich and other cast members joining for Season 2.

If you haven't watched Bad Monkey yet, its style is completely different from Lawrence's other comedies, with a much darker tone. But it is absolutely worth a watch. If you're not so fond of the heartwarming feel of Lasso or Shrinking, Bad Monkey might be more to your taste.

Season 1 of Bad Monkey is currently available on Apple TV.

Are you a fan of Bad Monkey? Or are you planning to catch up on Season 1 before the Season 2 premiere? Let us know in the comments section.

Apple TV costs US$12.99 per month, and can also be subscribed to through an Apple One bundle discount.
